notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control a basic Plains.
description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {2}{W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response to this trigger, activate Earthcraft by tapping Battalion Foot Soldier, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier and putting it on the bottom of your library, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Battalion Foot Soldier's trigger, searching your library for a card named Battalion Foot Soldier and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.
